title: 8 September 1961: Live: St John's Hall, Liverpool
content:
This was The Beatles’ 11th and final performance at St John’s Hall on Snaefell Avenue in Tuebrook, Liverpool.

Mona Best, mother of Pete and owner of the Casbah Coffee Club, also ran some nights at St John’s Hall. The venue shouldn’t be confused with a hall in Bootle of the same name where The Beatles also performed.

The Beatles played at Liverpool’s St John’s Hall on 11 occasions. The other dates were 17 February; 10 March; 13, 20 and 27 July; 3, 10, 17, 24 and 31 August 1961.

Page last updated: 24 January 2024

  • 1980: Interview: John Lennon for Newsweek

  • 1970: Recording: All Things Must Pass by George Harrison
  • 1969: Ringo Starr is rushed to hospital

  • 1962: The Beatles live: Majestic Ballroom, Birkenhead
